design_description: A bold black-and-gold identity built on the Legacy template, inspired by timeless football heritage and luxury aesthetics. The oversized vertical gold cross structure creates a powerful centerpiece that feels iconic and instantly recognizable. The clean symmetry and minimal detailing give the jersey a premium, almost ceremonial presence. Gold trims on the collar, sleeves, crest, and sponsor reinforce the elegant and dominant visual language. Overall, the design feels classic, authoritative, and sophisticated — like a modern elite club with royal undertones.
